overview: Premium 3D animated website for Shreya Makeup & Hair — a bridal makeup and hair styling studio in Karwar, Karnataka. Features a luxurious beige and brown light theme with warm golden glow effects, glassmorphism cards, and advanced React Three Fiber 3D animations throughout.
features: Premium 3D animated hero section with warm golden floating orbs and particles
Beige and brown light theme with golden glow and blur effects
Services section with glassmorphism cards for bridal, hair styling, party makeup
Portfolio gallery displaying all 8 bridal photos with lightbox
Indian testimonials with South Indian bride context
Why Choose Us section with 3D animated icons
FAQ accordion with Karwar studio info
